standard_prerequisites.name: Classical Hurwitz-Radon anticommuting orthonormal antisymmetric integer matrices
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author Lemma4, explicitly citing Geramita and Pullman [2] for a self-contained construction; original full bibliography retained.

standard_prerequisites.name: Binomial coefficient entropy estimates and Kronecker products
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author proof of Theorem1 and Theorem9; binary entropy is named in the author text.

core_obligations: Convert sum-of-squares composition identities to Hurwitz-Radon matrix conditions.
Construct low-dimensional parity representations and combine them with anticommuting matrix products.
Optimize the binomial parameters via entropy estimates to obtain exponent below1.62.
Retain the complete positive-characteristic appendix construction and the characteristic-two case.
difficulty_reason: The author builds a new parity representation from multilinear interpolation, combines it with classical anticommuting matrices by tensor products, and optimizes the resulting sum-of-squares construction using entropy. The positive-characteristic case requires a distinct binomial-matrix interpolation argument, whose full author proof is included. These are nonroutine algebraic constructions.

Theorem1 is one counted result including complex and positive-characteristic cases; finite-parameter Theorem9 and all parity/matrix lemmas remain uncounted supporting author construction.
